title: A staff session in the OTA admin
caption: Cookies __Host-vx_staff_at (15 min) and __Host-vx_staff_rt (family, at most 12 h) on the admin; family staffsess:<familyId> in Redis. Code: lib/session.ts, middleware.ts, lib/refresh-dedup.ts.

states.label: Active (access token valid)
states.detail: Pages and actions call the API with the access token only.

states.label: Expiring (< 60 s left or gone)
states.detail: The middleware or `requireStaff` refreshes, de-duplicated per refresh token.

states.label: Refresh failed, may pass
states.detail: `429`, `503`, network: cookies kept; `/auth/refresh` answers a "Try again" page.

states.label: Ended
states.detail: Refresh refused (`REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID`, `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED`, `STAFF_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`): access, refresh and env cookies cleared, sent to the portal.

transitions.label: POST /sso with a valid portal token
refresh refused or family over 12 h
staffdeny:* stamp (member removed, sign out everywhere) within 60 s
Open console again from the portal
Open console again from the portal
